name: academy-workbench-handoff
description: Private academy consumer module with preserved sources, standalone synthetic runtime and pinned agent-platform contracts

scripts.check: bun run typecheck:context && bun run check:context && bun run check:inquiry && bun run check:student-audit && bun run check:student-viewer && bun run check:academy-context && bun run check:class-timetable
scripts.test: bun run test:inquiry && bun run test:student-audit && bun run test:student-viewer && bun run test:academy-context && bun run test:class-timetable
scripts.check:academy-context: bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p context/academy-context/tsconfig.json && bun context/academy-context/cli.ts inspect
scripts.check:class-timetable: bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p context/class-timetable/tsconfig.json && bun context/class-timetable/check-routing.ts && bun run test:class-timetable
